adversarial_framing_finding: Iran-war/Houthi/Red Sea security context surfaced in-window, but in-window (Aug 18) coverage frames Saudi Arabia as the victim of Houthi attacks (Aramco Jazan/Jizan refinery targeting); aggressor-framed items casting Saudi Arabia as attacker (Al Jazeera Hodeidah strikes, US-Saudi strikes condemnation) are late-July, out of window. No in-window aggressor/oppressor framing found.
notes: Negative Articles section legitimately empty this edition. Nothing manufactured or padded.
